name: ProcessCreate
records: Process creation: full command line (current and parent); ProcessGuid; hash of the image (HashType algorithms)

name: FileCreateTime
records: A process explicitly changed a file's creation time (anti-forensics indicator)

name: NetworkConnect
records: TCP/UDP connection: source process (ProcessId/ProcessGuid); source/destination IP; port; hostname; disabled by default

name: n/a (service state change)
records: Sysmon service started or stopped; cannot be filtered

name: ProcessTerminate
records: Process terminated: UtcTime; ProcessGuid; ProcessId

name: DriverLoad
records: Driver loaded: configured hashes and signature information (signature created asynchronously)

name: ImageLoad
records: Module (DLL) loaded in a process: hashes and signature; disabled by default (needs -l)

name: CreateRemoteThread
records: Process created a thread in another process: source/target process; StartAddress/StartModule/StartFunction

name: RawAccessRead
records: Process performed raw (\\.\ ) read access on a drive: source process and target device

name: ProcessAccess
records: A process opened another process (e.g. LSASS credential theft detection)

name: FileCreate
records: File created or overwritten (useful for autostart/temp/download locations)

name: RegistryEvent (Object create and delete)
records: Registry key/value create or delete

name: RegistryEvent (Value Set)
records: Registry value set; records the value for DWORD/QWORD types

name: RegistryEvent (Key and Value Rename)
records: Registry key or value renamed: records the new name

name: FileCreateStreamHash
records: Named file stream created; hash of the unnamed stream and the named stream contents (e.g. Zone.Identifier mark-of-the-web)

name: ServiceConfigurationChange
records: Sysmon's own configuration changed (e.g. filtering rules updated); cannot be filtered

name: PipeEvent (Pipe Created)
records: Named pipe created

name: PipeEvent (Pipe Connected)
records: Named pipe client/server connection made

name: WmiEvent (WmiEventFilter activity detected)
records: WMI event filter registered: namespace; filter name; filter expression

name: WmiEvent (WmiEventConsumer activity detected)
records: WMI event consumer registered: consumer name; log; destination

name: WmiEvent (WmiEventConsumerToFilter activity detected)
records: WMI consumer bound to a filter: consumer name and filter path

name: DNSEvent (DNS query)
records: Process executed a DNS query (success or fail; cached or not); requires Windows 8.1+

name: FileDelete (File Delete archived)
records: File deleted; the deleted file is also archived to ArchiveDirectory (default C:\Sysmon)

name: ClipboardChange (New content in the clipboard)
records: System clipboard contents changed

name: ProcessTampering (Process image change)
records: Process image tampering detected (e.g. process hollowing/herpaderping)

name: FileDeleteDetected (File Delete logged)
records: File deleted (logged only; not archived; compare event 23)

name: FileBlockExecutable
records: Sysmon detected and blocked creation of an executable (PE) file

name: FileBlockShredding
records: Sysmon detected and blocked file shredding (e.g. by SDelete-like tools)

name: FileExecutableDetected
records: Sysmon detected creation of a new executable (PE) file

name: Error
records: An internal Sysmon error occurred (heavy system load; bug; or unmet security/integrity condition)
